title: Closure of Polynomial Time Under Intersection
statement: Let $p$ and $q$ be predicates on finite binary strings. If the languages $\\{z : p(z)\\}$ and $\\{z : q(z)\\}$ both belong to $\\mathsf{P}$, then their intersection language $\\{z : p(z) \\text{ and } q(z)\\}$ belongs to $\\mathsf{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: The language defined by $p$ belongs to $\\mathsf{P}$
The language defined by $q$ belongs to $\\mathsf{P}$
